column1: # The single source for the visual language.
# Launcher entries, badge PNGs, and config-<profile> files are all generated from this.
# badge   = Mission Control side-stripe hue (what you see at thumbnail scale)
# cursor  = cursor color in the window (what you see while typing)
# These are deliberately independent: sonnet pairs a green badge with Gruvbox's amber
# cursor. Badge answers "which window is that?", cursor answers "where am I typing?".
